lines.zh: 我贴着围栏走，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I move along the fence with light steps.
My claws scrape the concrete.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌踩在湿泥上，无声。
lines.en: My feet press the wet mud, silent.

lines.zh: 我的条纹在阴影里断开。
lines.en: My stripes break up in the shadow.
I work around to the far side of the fence.
I walk very quietly.

lines.zh: 我贴着铁栏走，鳞片蹭出响。
lines.en: I walk along the bars, scales scraping.
I stop and lift my head.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过水沟，没出声。
lines.en: I step over the ditch without a sound.
I head toward the viewing platform.
I stop at the gate.

lines.zh: 我贴着围栏走，试着咬锁。
lines.en: I pace the fence, testing the lock with my teeth.
I stand with my neck stretched slightly forward.

lines.zh: 我把脖子扭成一个不自然的角度。
lines.en: I twist my neck to an unnatural angle.
I listen beyond the fence.

lines.zh: 我伏在阴影里，只露一只眼。
lines.en: I lie in the shadow, only one eye showing.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里发出咔哒声。
lines.en: A clicking sound rises in my throat.
I am working out how far you are.
My spine arches slightly.
I wait for the gate to open.
My nostrils flare.
I run my tongue over my lips.

lines.zh: 这具身体是为捕猎造的。
lines.en: This body was built for hunting.
Your smell is familiar to me.
You are on the other side of the fence.
I am clever, you know.
Your hand is on the latch.
My eyes are yellow.

lines.zh: 我隔着铁栏，看你手里的钥匙。
lines.en: Through the bars, I eye the key in your hand.
Do you want to come in?

lines.zh: 我没有眨眼，琥珀色的眼。
lines.en: I don't blink; my eyes are amber.
We look at each other through the bars.
I know how tall these bars are.
I hiss.
I twist away.
This makes me angrier.

lines.zh: 混出来的猎手，五十五点血。
lines.en: A spliced hunter with fifty-five health.
I will remember.
Pain? This little wound only makes me hungrier.
You dare lay a hand on my scales?
I've memorized the smell of your blood.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅你的手套，退开。
lines.en: I sniff your glove and step back.
What I smell is meat.
Throw the meat over.
I watch it land.
My claws catch and I climb the wall.

lines.zh: 你的手一动，我的瞳孔就缩了。
lines.en: When your hand moves, my pupils narrow.
You have more on you.

lines.zh: 混种的牙，这点东西不够。
lines.en: A hybrid's teeth. This is not enough.
Come closer.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片刮过你的护甲。
lines.en: My scales scrape your armor.

lines.zh: 我被撞得侧过身，又转回来。
lines.en: Knocked sideways, I turn back around.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我低头看你的手。
lines.en: You hit me; I lower my head to your hands.
Mud splashes over both of us.
You should remember that.

lines.zh: 我的黑鳞擦过你的肩膀。
lines.en: My black scales graze your shoulder.

lines.zh: 别挡路，我的爪子可不认人。
lines.en: Out of my way — my claws don't do introductions.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，我就把你叼走。
lines.en: One more step and I'll drag you off.

lines.zh: 实验室里还有别的样本。
lines.en: There are other samples in the lab.
I patrol this fence alone.
I look up at the lights.
It is quiet inside the enclosure.
There is only one line of prints.

lines.zh: 我蹭了蹭她的颈侧，继续巡栏。
lines.en: I nuzzle her neck, then resume patrolling.
The light sweeps by again.

lines.zh: 跟我来，这片林子归我们。
lines.en: Follow me — this forest is ours now.

lines.zh: 我低头嗅了嗅，一口咬住。
lines.en: I sniff it, then bite down.
This is not one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我叼起来，先看看有没有用。
lines.en: I pick it up and check if it is useful.
Flung aside, out of the way.
It breaks in my jaws.

lines.zh: 我用后爪刨开土，把它藏好。
lines.en: I scrape the soil with a hind claw and hide it.

lines.zh: 我叼起它，牙印留在上面。
lines.en: I pick it up, leaving tooth marks.
That scent... it's mine now.
My head snaps around.
I freeze and stare at you.
You are shaking on the other side.

lines.zh: 我的背脊棘刺全竖起来了。
lines.en: The quills along my spine all rise.
Now I understand.
You opened it.

lines.zh: 我这身黑鳞，在夜里看不见。
lines.en: This black hide vanishes at night.
The fence is too low.
Stop running.

lines.zh: 我听见你踩碎了一根树枝。
lines.en: I heard you snap a twig.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫倒了走廊的灯。
lines.en: My tail knocks over the corridor lamp.

lines.zh: 我的步子轻，落不到你耳里。
lines.en: My steps are light; they never reach your ears.
You look back and cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我绕到下风处，不让你闻到。
lines.en: I circle downwind so you can't smell me.
You are nearly spent.
I move along the railing.
The gate is open.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地板上敲三下。
lines.en: My claw taps the floor three times.
Head tilted, I listen to your heartbeat.
I stop a few paces away.

lines.zh: 我沿围栏走，爪子刮着水泥。
lines.en: I pace the fence, claws scraping concrete.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，混种的骨头在响。
lines.en: I lower my head; my hybrid bones creak.

lines.zh: 实验室的灯照出我的影子。
lines.en: The lab lights cast my shadow.
I bite your shoulder.
My claws rake your back.
My tail knocks you down.
This claw is the second strike.
The second gets through.

lines.zh: 我是混出来的，没有族谱。
lines.en: I was spliced, no lineage.
I bite again.
You kick my jaw.
I shake my head, flinging blood on the wall.

lines.zh: 我的前爪按住你的胸口。
lines.en: My foreclaws pin your chest.
My sickle claw hooks your calf.

lines.zh: 培养槽打开了，我走出来。
lines.en: The tank opens and I step out.

lines.zh: 围栏的灯，一盏盏照着我。
lines.en: The enclosure lamps light me one by one.
The enclosure lights fall on me.
I test the concrete under my feet.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在门上留了痕。
lines.en: My claws leave marks on the gate.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，闻到空气里的味道。
lines.en: I lift my head and smell the air.
This world is bigger than the lab.

lines.zh: 我的条纹第一次见到阳光。
lines.en: My stripes see sunlight for the first time.
I walk toward the fence.
I open my jaws and try a call.
The sound carries far.
Spliced claws tap the ground.
I am ready to start.

lines.zh: 培养槽的玻璃碎了，我出来了。
lines.en: The growth tank's glass breaks; I'm out.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，我扭身躲开。
lines.en: Fire catches my back and I twist away.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，腿先着地。
lines.en: I drop from a height and land on my legs.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的脖子，我拼命往上游。
lines.en: Water rises past my neck and I fight upward.
The blast slams me into the fence.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在侧腹，扎得很深。
lines.en: An arrow in my flank, and deep.

lines.zh: 咒光打在我身上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Spell-light hits me and I shudder.
It has been long since I had meat.
Lightning strikes and I flatten myself.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面可以扑。
lines.en: There is no ground to spring from in the void.
